en.quote: When preparing the three-year budget, these scenarios were not taken into account or examined.
en.head: Pension reform was proposed within the same budget period.
en.body: “These scenarios” referred to raising the retirement age in the preparation of the 2017–2019 budget. In June 2018 the government proposed an increase starting in 2019. The later proposal does not show that the scenario was studied in 2016; it shows a policy shift within the period then under discussion.
